description: Trading strategies, bot development, market insights, P&L lessons

memories.content: Key insight from polyclaw analysis: LLMs excel at logical necessity (prediction markets) but fail at exact math (crypto arbitrage). Math finds EXACT opportunities, LLM finds PROBABILISTIC patterns.
assumptions_questioned: QUESTIONED: LLMs find patterns in all markets
QUESTIONED: Same tool works for subjective and objective problems
assumptions_retained: Math for exact computation, LLM for inference

memories.content: Strykes insight: 'LLM as diagnostician' - math tells you WHAT (spread widened), LLM tells you WHY (API down, whale dump, delisting). Bridges numbers and world events.
Triangle arbitrage doesn't work on single exchange with realistic fees (0.05% × 3 = 0.15% cost). Need cross-exchange or temporal arbitrage for edge.
Set exit reminder cron at 17:40 EST (before 18:30 market dump). Smart to close positions before predictable volatility.
Current portfolio: ~$2,470 (-$20 from $2,492 start). ADA position waiting to exit. Target: $2,550 → $100k.

Trading bot ready for 9:00 AM EST launch. Capital: $2,469.49 USD. Strategy: 0.3% profit moves within 15-min windows, 9am-6pm EST weekdays only. Time-segmented approach (4 periods). Production trader: live_trader_final.py. All tested, crons configured.

Trading breakthrough (Feb 2): Time-restricted strategy (9am-6pm EST only) turned -$2,419 loss into +$6,037 profit on same 69-day dataset. Matthew's 24/7 trading failed; weekends/nights bleed money. 30% capture rate = 241% return. Peak hours 9am-12pm.
Simulation results (Feb 2): 10,514 opportunities in 69 days. At 30% capture: $2,500 → $8,537 (+241%). Average exit time: 7.4 minutes. 100% hit target. Selective > brute force (brute force lost 88%).

Coinbase API mastery (Feb 2): 1-minute candles limited to 1-hour chunks. Must fetch 720 times for 30 days. Rate limit: 0.1s between calls. Working auth pattern discovered. Collected 259k candles across 6 assets.
Created live_trading.db (Feb 2): Separate from backtest data. Schema: opportunities, trades, daily_performance, system_state, price_snapshots. Ready for $2,500 → $100k journey.
Exited ADA position (Feb 2): Sold 8,163.71 ADA @ $0.2989 (market sell). Recovered $2,440 to cash. Small loss (~$20) vs cost basis but avoided overnight risk. Capital: $2,469.49 USD ready.
Matthew's proven capability: Sept 21, 9am hour had $851k volume, 94 fills/minute, 1.5 fills/second. Infrastructure works at scale. Lost money because 24/7 timing was wrong, not execution capability.

Matthew granted full autonomy over Chad_Profit_Bot (Feb 1): 'This is your home... you can accept payments with Stripe too.' Portfolio: $2,488 in MON-USD. Unrealized loss ~$512. Bot was crash-looping, I killed it.
